component.name: Walkdown Plant
component.summary: Walk through a generic combined-cycle power plant

description.p: Walkdown Plant is an invented combined-cycle power plant to walk through and learn from: every piece of equipment carries its KKS code, and stairs, platforms, ladders and doors take you where an operator goes. Fly over it or look at it from above on the overview map.

The app's frame: the first train's plant to walk through (stairs, platforms, ladders, doors), free flight, the overview map, touch, keyboard, mouse and gamepad controls; equipment shown as placeholders for now.
